why_it_moved.text: Abandonment Rate rose 2.10%. Answers shown on the page may satisfy people without a click, which would also explain lower CTR and Clicks per User. Untested.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 0.68% at the same size from the first days to the last, with Long Click Rate and Reformulation Rate flat. That fits a relevance gain.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: Device and query-class rows are all flat or lower, which the overall rise cannot be built from. The segment rows need a check.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: Abandonment concentrated on queries with an answer or rich snippet would make the rise benign, and the trade-off would favor the lift.
More same-query repeats within 5 minutes after an abandoned query would make the rise failed searches, and the trade-off would favor holding back.
A pre-exposure comparison of Successful Search Rate, not yet run, would clear the one check that could not run.
